{{Quote|He's a member of the Thirty-seven Families from Deservo. Bitter rivals of the Tion ruling family.|Melarra, on Sannus Lorrick|<ref name="TOR:KUS">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Kaon Under Siege}}</ref>}}
The '''Thirty-seven Families''' was a group of noble families from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]]. [[Sannus Lorrick]] was a member of the families, and they were bitter rivals with the ruling [[House of Tion/Legends|royal family]] of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:KUS" />
